Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. Zero would suffice as "equal" if any effect were around looking to
change control of the minion. But no effect is. The only effects that look for
zero or more corruption counters are ones that place the counters themselves
first, so you end up with a counter.

Messages.Author: PaulW...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:


So if you control a Cave of Apples you can take control of "free"
allies without having to place corruption counters on them first?

Messages.Author: ira...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:


No, you still need to take one action, due to card text on Cave of
Apples. "If the action is successful and the number of your
corruption counters on that minion equals or exceeds..."

Ira

Cave of Apples
Master
Any Follower of Set you control may put a corruption counter on an
ally or younger vampire controlled by your prey as a (D) action. If
the action is successful and the number of your corruption counters on
the minion equals or exceeds his or her capacity or cost, you may burn
those counters to gain control of him or her.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <6145fbdb-dc2f-445c...@59g2000hsb.googlegroups

.com>, PaulW...@gmail.com writes:
>So if you control a Cave of Apples you can take control of "free"
>allies without having to place corruption counters on them first?

No. Card text.

If the action is successful and the number of your corruption
counters on the minion equals or exceeds his or her capacity or
cost, you may burn those counters to gain control of him or her.

You only get to do the burn and steal "If the action is successful".
